Here’s a table of the **top 10 holdings of the Nasdaq-100 (NDX)** as of the latest available data (June 2024), including their **market capitalization** and **P/E (Price-to-Earnings) ratio**. Note that these figures fluctuate daily based on market conditions.

| **Rank** | **Company**               | **Ticker** | **Market Cap (USD)** | **P/E Ratio (TTM)** | **Weight in NDX (%)** |
|----------|---------------------------|------------|----------------------|---------------------|-----------------------|
| 1        | Microsoft                 | MSFT       | ~$3.2 trillion       | ~38.5               | ~9.5%                 |
| 2        | Apple                     | AAPL       | ~$3.1 trillion       | ~32.0               | ~8.5%                 |
| 3        | NVIDIA                    | NVDA       | ~$3.0 trillion       | ~75.0               | ~7.5%                 |
| 4        | Amazon                    | AMZN       | ~$1.9 trillion       | ~55.0               | ~5.5%                 |
| 5        | Meta (Facebook)           | META       | ~$1.2 trillion       | ~28.0               | ~4.5%                 |
| 6        | Alphabet (Google) - Class A | GOOGL    | ~$2.2 trillion       | ~28.0               | ~4.0%                 |
| 7        | Alphabet (Google) - Class C | GOOG     | ~$2.2 trillion       | ~28.0               | ~3.5%                 |
| 8        | Tesla                     | TSLA       | ~$550 billion        | ~45.0               | ~3.0%                 |
| 9        | Broadcom                  | AVGO       | ~$500 billion        | ~50.0               | ~2.5%                 |
| 10       | Costco                    | COST       | ~$350 billion        | ~55.0               | ~2.0%                 |

### **Key Notes:**
1. **Market Cap & P/E Data**: Sourced from **Yahoo Finance, Bloomberg, or Nasdaq** (as of June 2024). P/E ratios are **trailing twelve months (TTM)**.
2. **Weight in NDX**: The Nasdaq-100 is **market-cap-weighted**, so larger companies have a bigger impact.
3. **Recent Changes**:
   - **NVIDIA** has surged in weight due to AI-driven growth.
   - **Tesla** has seen its weight decline due to stock performance.
4. **Exclusions**: Some companies (e.g., **Adobe, Netflix, PepsiCo**) are in the top 15 but not the top 10.

### **Where to Verify?**
- [Nasdaq Official Holdings](https://indexes.nasdaq.com/)
- [Yahoo Finance (NDX)](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NDX/holdings/)
- [Bloomberg (NDX)](https://www.bloomberg.com/quote/NDX:IND)
